meta.name: The Irregulars
meta.description:
In Victorian London, a gang of troubled street teens are manipulated into solving crimes for the sinister Doctor Watson and his mysterious business partner, the elusive Sherlock Holmes. As the crimes take on a horrifying supernatural edge and a dark power emerges, it'll be up to the Irregulars to come together to save not only London but the entire world.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Chapter One: An Unkindness in London
videos.overview: As Jessie's nightmares grow worse, Bea accepts Dr. Whatson's job offer to investigate four kidnapped babies - and receives some unexpectedly posh help.

videos.title: Chapter Two: The Ghosts of 221B
videos.overview: Broke and in trouble, Bea reluctantly partners with Jessie to find out who's stealing children's teeth. Spike spies on Watson and Sherlock Holmes.

videos.title: Chapter Three: Ipsissimus
videos.overview: A gruesome murder sends Bea and her crew undercover at a country estate to determine whether the killer is part of a secret paranormal society.

videos.title: Chapter Four: Both the Needle and the Knife
videos.overview: Jessie comes face to face with Inspector Lestrade at a crime scene, Bea plays cat and mouse with Watson, and Leo feels torn over his life at the palace.

videos.title: Chapter Five: Students of the Unhallowed Arts
videos.overview: Bea discovers more about her mother's long-ago connection to Holmes and Watson, while Billy contemplates revenge after a brutal reminder of his past.

videos.title: Chapter Six: Hieracium Snowdoniense
videos.overview: Bea suspects a spate of stolen body parts links to an old case, Jessie approaches Sherlock about her nightmares. Leo makes a stand for his future.

videos.title: Chapter Seven: The Ecstasy of Death
videos.overview: After demanding the truth from Waton, Bea joins a plan to catch the Linen Man. Jessie fights her fears. Spike scrambles to keep his friends together.

videos.title: Chapter Eight: The Ecstasy of Life
videos.overview: As London descends into chaos, Bea and her crew head underground, where together they face untold horror in a dangerous quest to locate the rip.

meta.slogan: A darkness has come to London.
